comments.author: INKU
comments.body_html:
Slothgang - I believe I found a way to fix the exponential ammo price bug - just needs a small hacky fix that I came up with. In your mod.ts in the src folder replace the priceAdjustment function with this:

private adjustPrice(itemDB: any, item: Item, scheme: IBarterScheme[][], assort: ITraderAssort) { const parent = itemDB[item._tpl]._parent; if (!this.config.categories[parent] || !this.config.categories[parent].priceAdjustment) { return; } if (this.isMoneyTrade(assort, item) && !item.priceAdjusted) { const priceAdjustment = this.config.categories[parent].priceAdjustment; scheme[0][0].count *= priceAdjustment; item.priceAdjusted = true; // Set the flag to indicate adjustment } }
